entry.readouts: frequencies of Ki67-positive proliferating leukocyte subsets

evidence.section: The YF17D vaccine up-regulates IL-1β production
evidence.quote: To do so, PBMCs from 6 volunteers, sampled at day 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, and 28 after vaccination, were stained with anti-Ki67and other specific antibodies to identify, by flow cytometry, different cell subsets that are actively proliferating.
